answer_1.quote: In this paper, we consider a new and specific setting of it, referred to as fact‑based text editing… We propose a model for fact‑based text editing called FACTEDITOR.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the results of revised texts by the models from the viewpoint of fluency and fidelity. We utilize ExactMatch (EM), BLEU and SARI scores as evaluation metrics for fluency. We also utilize precision, recall, and F1 score as evaluation metrics for fidelity.

answer_4.quote: We also manually evaluate 50 randomly sampled revised texts for WEBEDIT. We check whether the revised texts given by FACTEDITOR and ENCDECEDITOR include all the facts. We categorize the factual errors made by the two models.
answer_4.guideline: Check whether revised texts include all facts and categorize factual errors.
